controlContracts.label: Replay
controlContracts.description: Reconstruct inputs and ordered evidence without re-running side effects.
controlContracts.failure: Fails closed when inputs, adapter version, or evidence hashes are incomplete.

controlContracts.label: Suspend
controlContracts.description: Pause only the recorder-owned disposable test agent.
controlContracts.failure: Fails closed unless target ownership, single-use approval, and post-action process state all verify.

controlContracts.label: Resume
controlContracts.description: Resume the recorder-owned disposable test agent after a verified suspension.
controlContracts.failure: Fails closed unless the target is owned, suspended, and covered by a fresh approval.

controlContracts.label: Terminate
controlContracts.description: Gracefully stop only the recorder-owned disposable test agent.
controlContracts.failure: Never accepts an arbitrary PID or shell command; an unverified exit is reported as unknown.
